HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Google Snake is a classic arcade game where you control a snake, eating food to grow longer while avoiding collisions with the walls and itself.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use arrow keys or swipe to control the snake's direction.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Eat the food (dots or fruits) to grow longer and score points.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Avoid hitting the walls or your own tail.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Experience the original Google Snake gameplay that's been loved for decades.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Easy-to-learn controls make Google Snake accessible to players of all ages.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: The Google Snake game becomes more challenging as the snake grows longer.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy the retro pixel art style of the Google Snake game.
